description.en: Hold the knife, push, blow the dust away

howToPlay.zh: 照着篆刻师傅的工序刻一方四字朱文印（字是凸的）：先倒边，再刻边框、刻十字分成四格，然后刻字、铲底，最后吹去石粉。刻刀分两个区域：按住白色刀柄拖动是移刀，按住朱红色握把往上推就是刻。刀和视频里一样只往前推（屏幕上方），往回拉只会顺着刻过的槽退回；刀尖前的小点就是落刀点。要刻横线，就在刀以外的地方（印面或垫子上）绕着印石划，把印石转过来，转到接近 90° 时会吸住、松手自动对正。落刀点靠近稿线时会吸到线上，稿线变黄就是对准了（设置里可以关掉「对线辅助」）。刻字时沿笔画中间往上推一刀，刀的两刃会在笔画两侧同时刻出轮廓，笔画不会被刻坏。铲底时按住握把在字周围来回划，把空白铲掉，铲到八成半剩下的自动铲净。刻偏了点刀尖旁的 ↶ 撤销最后一划；右上角「重刻」可以只重刻当前这一步，或者整方从头再来。最后点印面上的「吹」吹净石粉，印蜕收进「印谱」并解锁下一方。印面上刻的是反字，盖出来才是正的。电脑上同理用鼠标。键盘：方向键移刀，按住空格下刀、同时按上方向键往前推，Q 和 E 转动印石，Z 撤销，B 吹粉，A 打开印谱。
howToPlay.en: Carve a four-character seal with raised characters (朱文), the way a seal carver does: chamfer the face's edges, cut the border and a cross into four cells, carve the characters, clear the ground, blow the powder away. The knife has two zones: drag the white handle to move it, hold the cinnabar grip and push up to carve. As in the video it only pushes forward (up the screen); drawing back slides it down its own groove. The dot ahead of its point is where it will cut. For a line across, draw an arc around the stone anywhere off the knife to turn it; it settles near each quarter turn and squares itself when you let go. Near a draft line the point settles onto it, and the line turns yellow (Line assist can be switched off in Settings). For the characters, push once up the middle of a stroke: the knife's two edges cut its outline on both sides, and the stroke itself is never cut. To clear the ground, hold the grip and scrub around the characters; at 85% the rest is cleared for you. ↶ beside the point undoes the last swipe; Redo (top right) starts the current step, or the whole seal, over. Tap Blow on the face at the end: the print goes into Seals and the next seal opens. The face is carved mirrored so that it prints the right way round. A mouse works the same way. Keyboard: arrow keys move the knife; hold Space and Up to push; Q and E turn the stone, Z undoes, B blows, A opens your seals.
